name: freqz
expr: [h, w] = freqz([1 0.5], 1, 8); r1 = double(numel(h)); r2 = double(numel(w)); [hw, ww] = freqz([1 1], 1, 4, 'whole');
comment: Sig [h,w]=freqz(b,a,n[,'whole']). Default grid w = pi*(0:n-1)/n on [0,pi). 'whole' -> w = 2*pi*(0:n-1)/n on the full unit circle [0,2pi): freqz([1 1],1,4,'whole') w=[0 pi/2 pi 3pi/2], |h(1)|=2. numkit previously ignored 'whole' -- now honored. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
